findings.title: geocode/reverse Guid.Empty short-circuit is load-bearing AND untestable with the current singleton FakeGeoService — the real production 500 can ship green
findings.detail: Only SuggestAsync has the Guid.Empty bypass (GeoService.cs:28-33). GeocodeAsync/ReverseAsync call geoCache.GetOrAddAsync(Guid.Empty,...) unconditionally; on cache miss + upstream Success, GeoCache.UpsertL2Async Adds a GeoCacheEntry{FleetId=Guid.Empty} + usageRecorder.RecordAsync(Guid.Empty) — both FK-constrained to fleets -> InvalidOperationException -> 500 via DontCatchExceptions(). AC#5 'never 500' therefore REQUIRES the endpoint-level short-circuit for geocode/reverse. Test-fidelity gap: FakeGeoService is a singleton whose ReverseAsync/GeocodeAsync IGNORE fleetId (FakeGeoService.cs:91-119), so the DegradesFoundFalse test passes with or without the short-circuit; defaults already yield found:false so the test cannot RED.
findings.suggested_fix: Make the test RED-able: set FakeGeoService.ReverseResult/GeocodeResult to a POSITIVE (Found=true) result and assert the endpoint STILL returns found:false with no resolvable fleet — fails unless the endpoint short-circuits on Guid.Empty before calling GeoService. State plainly that geocode/reverse have NO SuggestAsync-style bypass. Optionally one non-fake integration test pinning the real FK path.

findings.title: WI-3 AC depends on theme.zIndex which only WI-2 creates, but WI-3 has no depends_on — 'all four independently verifiable/concurrent' is false
findings.detail: theme.ts/theme.d.ts have touchTargets but NO zIndex today. WI-2 adds theme.zIndex; WI-3's BottomSheet AC requires it but does not touch theme.ts and declares no depends_on — WI-3's own 'tsc green' AC cannot pass before WI-2.
findings.suggested_fix: Add depends_on:[WI-2] to WI-3 (or one owner for the zIndex token); correct the concurrency claim in the work-items doc.

findings.title: WI-2/3/4 all edit the same six i18n locale JSONs — concurrent execution collides; only sequential is safe
findings.detail: files_touched for WI-2, WI-3, WI-4 each list all six locale files. Parity coverage is present, but three parallel WIs writing the same six JSONs conflict. The 'concurrent-safe' claim is false w.r.t. these files.
findings.suggested_fix: Sequence the web WIs; note in the work-items doc that the shared i18n files force sequential execution; each WI keeps its own key group.

findings.title: Keep the rate-limit guard position identical when re-keying (400-before-429 ordering)
findings.detail: FE validation 400 (min 3 chars) runs before HandleAsync and is unaffected; the guard must stay first in HandleAsync with only the key source changed (sub -> else anon hash of ip|slug|'anon').
findings.suggested_fix: Re-key the guard in place; promote the anon-hash stability unit test (fixed IP -> stable Guid, differs from UUIDv7 space) from optional to required.

findings.title: shared/ui placement is fine (shared list is non-exhaustive: shared/test, shared/perf already exist)
findings.detail: BottomSheet+SearchingLoader consumed by 2+ features (UC-015/016/019) — promotion rule satisfied.

findings.title: CustomerMapShell must remain a SIBLING of CustomerLayout (never nested) to avoid double ensureFleetSlug/silent-refresh
findings.detail: The shell re-implements the one-shot initializers; nesting under CustomerLayout in UC-015 would double-run them. No live risk in this UC (no router entry added).
findings.suggested_fix: Pin sibling-not-nested in WI-2 notes + shell doc comment; extend the enablesSilentRefresh once-assert to guard double-invoke.
